articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Video and Audio Streams
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring real-time reasoning over continuous video and audio input streams with significantly reduced latency compared to the initial GPT-5 release earlier this year. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on complex agentic benchmarks and introduces a new structured tool-use protocol that allows chaining of dozens of API calls within a single inference pass. This positions it as a backbone for autonomous agent frameworks that are rapidly proliferating across enterprise workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad 2026 Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2, augmented with an improved AlphaProof-style reinforcement learning pipeline, solved four of six problems from the 2026 IMO, corresponding to a silver medal. The system combines large-scale language model reasoning with formal theorem-proving in Lean 4, marking a significant step toward AI systems that can conduct rigorous mathematical research. The result improves on last year's gold-medal-equivalent performance by tackling harder combinatorics problems that previously stumped AI solvers.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Persistent Memory and Long-Horizon Task Planning
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4, featuring a persistent episodic memory system that allows the model to retain and recall context across sessions without re-prompting, along with a built-in planning module for multi-step task decomposition over hours-long workflows. Internal evaluations show a 40% improvement in complex software engineering benchmarks like SWE-bench Ultra compared to Claude 3.5. The company also published a detailed safety analysis covering new alignment techniques used to manage risks associated with persistent autonomy.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started operating in limited pilot programs at BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and can autonomously navigate unstructured warehouse environments using onboard vision transformers. Early reports indicate the robots can perform pick-and-place and palletizing tasks at roughly 70% of human worker speed with a sub-1% error rate.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Swarm Coordination Capabilities
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, under Hyundai's ownership, revealed the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot platform with a new multi-agent coordination system allowing up to 12 units to collaboratively perform construction and logistics tasks. The swarm intelligence layer uses a shared world model synchronized over 5G, enabling real-time task reallocation when individual units encounter obstacles. Pre-orders from major construction firms have reportedly exceeded 2,000 units for 2027 delivery.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Manufacturing, Partners with OpenAI for Embodied Reasoning
articles.summary: Figure Robotics closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Jeff Bezos's Bezos Expeditions, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot factory in Ohio capable of producing 10,000 units annually by late 2027. Figure also deepened its partnership with OpenAI, integrating GPT-5-based embodied reasoning models that allow its Figure 02 robot to interpret complex natural language instructions and execute multi-step physical tasks in novel environments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node, Promises 20% Efficiency Gain for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of risk production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, with volume production targeted for Q3 2027. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, delivering a projected 20% power efficiency improvement and 10% performance uplift over the N2 node. Major customers including NVIDIA, Apple, and AMD are expected to be early adopters, with next-generation AI training accelerators being a primary design target.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096-Electrode Array
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which quadruples the electrode count to 4,096 channels and features on-chip signal processing that dramatically reduces wireless bandwidth requirements. The second-generation device targets both motor restoration for paralysis patients and a new investigational indication for treatment-resistant depression. The approval follows 18 months of data from the first-generation implant trials, where patients demonstrated sustained cursor control and rudimentary text communication at speeds exceeding 60 words per minute.
